scenes.script:
Priya says: I am giving an interview.
Miss Nova says: Aise bolo, "I am taking an interview."
Priya says: He is my cousin brother.
Miss Nova says: Aise bolo, "He is my cousin."
Priya says: I belong to Delhi.
Miss Nova says: Aise bolo, "I am from Delhi."
Priya says: I am sleeping now.
Miss Nova says: Aise bolo, "I am going to sleep."
Priya says: How to learn English?
Miss Nova says: Mere saath speaking practice kijiye.
scenes.on_screen_text:
I am giving an interview.
I AM TAKING AN INTERVIEW.
He is my cousin brother.
HE IS MY COUSIN.
I belong to Delhi.
I AM FROM DELHI.
I am sleeping now.
I AM GOING TO SLEEP.
How to learn English?
PRACTICE SPEAKING WITH ME.

scenes.script: Miss Nova says: Main hoon Miss Nova, Supernova AI se. Main aapka English level analyze karke, aapke liye ek personalized plan ready karti hoon.
scenes.on_screen_text:
Supernova AI
PERSONALIZED PLAN
Khaas aapke liye

scenes.script: Miss Nova says: Raat ke 3 a.m. ko bhi 1000 mistakes kijiye. Koi nahi dekh raha, aur main aapko kabhi judge nahi karungi.
Miss Nova says: Main logic aapki language Hindi mein explain karti hoon, taaki aap sirf reading nahi, actually bolkar seekhein.
scenes.on_screen_text:
LOGIC AAPKI LANGUAGE MEIN
BOLKAR SEEKHEIN

scenes.script: Miss Nova says: Scrolling band kijiye. Din mein bas 15 minutes chahiye visible progress dekhne ke liye.
scenes.on_screen_text:
BAS 15 MINS ROZ
VISIBLE PROGRESS DEKHIYE

scenes.script: Miss Nova says: Supernova AI install kijiye aur aaj se hi English bolna start kijiye.
scenes.on_screen_text:
Supernova AI
English speaking app
Install Now

parsed.self_critique_fixed: I checked the script line-by-line to ensure perfect adherence to the Romanized, code-mixed Hindi rules. Taught lines in Scene 1 are kept 100% verbatim in English. Miss Nova's lines are warm and polite, using the 'aap' register ('kijiye', 'karungi') while maintaining a highly colloquial, spoken tone. Sanskritized words like 'vyaktigat' or 'truti' were avoided in favor of 'personalized' and 'mistakes'. The language self-reference was correctly localized to 'Hindi'. Syllable counts match the English source within the +/-20% budget.
